summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Sistema de Flujo de Aprobación para Catálogos con Panel de Tareas. All 20 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed including: Mis Tareas page navigation, KPIs display, Nueva Solicitud modal, Approval with password signature, Rejection with reason, and Permissions configuration modal.

issues: Console warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' - minor hydration issue in server select dropdown

critical_code_review_comments: Password verification for approval correctly uses verify_password() with hashed password from current_user
get_current_user() returns user with password field included (needed for approval signature verification)
Role-based access control properly implemented - Supervisor/Admin can approve, configure permissions
KPIs correctly count pending tasks, in-process, and solicitudes_pendientes_aprobar
All 9 catalogs available: puestos, tipos_incidencias, sucursales, departamentos, proveedores, categorias_presupuesto, almacenes, familias, categorias
seed_data_creation: Test solicitudes created during testing with TEST_ prefix
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sistema de Flujo de Aprobación fully tested. Key findings: 1) GET /api/sistema/catalogos-disponibles returns 9 catalogs. 2) GET /api/sistema/mis-tareas returns KPIs (pendientes, en_proceso, completadas, solicitudes_pendientes_aprobar). 3) POST /api/sistema/solicitudes creates new solicitud. 4) POST /api/sistema/solicitudes/{id}/aprobar requires password signature and returns 401 for wrong password. 5) POST /api/sistema/solicitudes/{id}/rechazar accepts motivo. 6) POST /api/sistema/permisos-catalogos assigns catalog permissions to users. 7) Only Supervisor/Admin see 'Por Aprobar' KPI and 'Configurar Permisos' section.
